main.description: The container a book club discussion hangs from: one book read cycle, one thread, one stable URI. Every post in the thread names this record's uri in its `thread`, so editing the title or description does not split the discussion across CIDs. The discussion itself is made of posts, not of this record: the opening text is the thread's first top-level post.

book.description: The edition record being discussed, e.g. a community.lexicon.book.edition at-uri. A plain at-uri rather than a strongRef: the thread follows the edition, it does not pin one revision of it.

description.description: Optional summary of the discussion: spoiler policy, chapters covered, reading window. The opening post carries the text the author wrote.

publishedAt.description: When the thread was published. Ordering key for the club's thread list.

read.description: The net.olamaelcu.livtet.biblio.bookClub.read cycle this thread belongs to. A plain at-uri: a thread never carries into a later read of the same book, and the cycle is identified by its uri, not by a revision.

title.description: The thread title shown in the club's list, e.g. the book title or a discussion prompt.
